# Source-derived Pumas HTTP advertisement fixture

The named types and versions come from public unmerged Pumas-Library PR51 at exact `80f06ab17f9eea639fee143c86319ca9b5e1a21c`: `rust/crates/pumas-core/src/build_info.rs`, `src/discovery/{mod,http}.rs`, and `rust/crates/pumas-rpc/src/discovery.rs`. This is a **source-derived conformance fixture**, not captured producer output or a running authenticated Pumas instance. Paths, UUIDs, start generation and test endpoint are authored test values. Test servers replace only endpoint/generation values for their real loopback listener. Package 0.7.0 matches that public source; optional compile-time provenance stays absent, and no compiled features/model readiness are fabricated. Model-reference and selector version numbers are opaque test values; this consumer does not negotiate or resolve those contracts.

The producer shapes distinguish HTTP service generation, core instance generation/library context and separate core/RPC build identities. Models and inference capabilities are intentionally absent. The browser crosses real HTTP through the production Tuldok routes and decoder, but launches no Pumas runtime and makes no inference/acquisition call. Source inspection and fixture tests do not qualify core IPC authentication, ownership, runtime readiness, release v0.8 or a trained model.
